purpose: Prespecified new-period external assessment of the existing frozen H2 sharing models, supplemented with independently trained return and volatility controls. Preserve every original v4 and H2 result.

classification.label: prespecified_new_period_external_assessment
classification.earlier_2025_use: A saved earlier three-asset notebook contains executed model test results spanning 2023-2025; this is separate from the current v4 thesis and its H2 fits.
classification.user_recollection: unsure; not treated as a declaration of no prior access
classification.older_project_directories_in_current_mou: tez_transformer and transformer_tez not present in the read-only user check
classification.coverage_limit: Inspection cannot prove that deleted, unsaved or inaccessible work never used 2026 data. Report this scope; do not claim an absolutely pristine holdout.

design.features: baseline; interleaved per-asset LogRet, Vol20; all eight inputs for every model
design.old_training_and_validation_arrays: Copy the 21 identities locked by the old T4 manifest; never resplit or refit scalers.
design.old_test_arrays: May be copied and hashed as opaque bytes only; not deserialized by staging or STL training.
design.new_period_rule: Select by target-realization date on the union calendar, preserve backward input history. No outcome-dependent date selection or window shifting.

stl_training.model_structure: Same SingleTaskTransformer branch structure as archived 08B, 8 inputs, 4 task outputs, d_model32, 4 heads, 2 layers, d_ff128, dropout0.1.
stl_training.initialization: For each seed instantiate the archived NoSharing template and copy each corresponding task branch into a disjoint independent STL model; record the mapping and initial state identities.
stl_training.batch_order: Same independently seeded mini-batch index order per seed across the two STL tasks; record hashes. Identical dropout streams across architectures are not claimed.
stl_training.checkpoint_selection: Earliest strict minimum of the task component of the archived normalized ValidationScore: mean of per-asset primary validation loss divided by the corresponding frozen per-asset baseline denominator.
stl_training.checkpoint_validation_denominators: Frozen return_denominator and volatility_denominator values from selection_baseline_denominators_v4.json; no new fit or recalibration.
stl_training.training_diagnostics: For every epoch report scaled training objective, raw-scale train/validation primary task loss and normalized validation task score using model.eval.
stl_training.independence_scope: STL has separate optimizers, gradient clipping and task-specific checkpoint selection; compare this independent-training bundle with MTL. It is not a pure isolated intervention on sharing alone.

new_period_data.gold_definition: GC=F gold futures price in USD; do not substitute the older GOLD_TRY series or gram gold.
new_period_data.historical_policy: Keep the original frozen history through 2024-12-31 byte-for-byte; acquired overlap is checked and differences reported, never used to overwrite the original history. Append only later dates.
new_period_data.calendar: Union of observed dates, ascending and unique; forward fill only, no backward fill. Report missing and forward-filled rows per asset.
new_period_data.volatility: sample standard deviation of the last20 log returns, ddof1, multiplied by sqrt252
new_period_data.targets: Return and Vol20 at the next union-calendar row; target order four returns then four volatilities.
new_period_data.scalers: Original train-fitted x_scaler and y_scaler; transform only.
new_period_data.quality_gate: Require finite positive observed prices, original ticker/column identities, at least150 actually observed price rows per asset within the new test period, chronological finite prepared targets, and at least150 new target dates. These are coverage gates, not a power guarantee. Report overlap revisions and missingness before any model metrics; do not silently replace instruments or dates.

outcomes.return_primary: Raw-scale MAE, averaged over four assets per target date
outcomes.volatility_primary: Raw-scale pinball tau0.5, averaged over four assets per target date
outcomes.seed_aggregation: Mean of the three per-seed loss series; not the loss of mean forecasts.
outcomes.reporting: All planned arms and seeds, per-asset descriptive details, seed mean and sample SD. Do not treat dates times seeds as independent observations.
outcomes.primary_comparisons: FS_same_width vs STL_pair and FS_budget_control vs STL_pair, separately for return and volatility: four tests in one primary Holm family.
outcomes.secondary_comparisons: The two FS arms vs NS_base for the two tasks: four tests in one separate secondary Holm family, report all.
outcomes.loss_difference_direction: Control loss minus full-sharing loss; positive favors sharing.

statistics.method: DM with Bartlett-HAC long-run variance and HLN h1 small-sample factor
statistics.lag0_sensitivity: Same four comparisons per family, explicitly separate sensitivity analyses; not used to replace primary decisions.

outcomes.overfitting_component: Report raw-primary-loss train/validation/new-test gaps and epoch learning curves. Gap direction is descriptive with only three seeds; it does not establish a causal reduction in overfitting, and the loss-series DM test is not a test of the gap.
outcomes.interpretation: Assess accuracy for each task and each FS control separately after multiplicity correction. A gain in only one task does not support both-task improvement. Even concordant gains and smaller gaps must be qualified by capacity, optimization, checkpoint-selection, prior-exposure and distribution-shift limits. Never relabel H2 as fully causally confirmed by gap direction alone.

gates.this_stage: Verify old identities, copy allowlisted inputs and code, record this plan, run no training or new-data access.
gates.training_stage: Train six STL models using old training and validation data only, then verify and freeze selected checkpoints.
gates.before_new_data: Finalize and lock acquisition/preparation/evaluation code hashes, this plan SHA and all existing and STL checkpoint identities in analysis_locked_v1.json before downloading new-period prices.
gates.amendments: Any necessary change is versioned with the reason and whether new data or outcomes had been accessed. Never overwrite an earlier plan or silently change decisions.
